about: Sam (the Fable review's first person, November 12, 2026): slips on most nights, opens Daybook now and then, tells some mornings and answers Welcome back honestly. The record shows only what he told: no badge across a night he did not tell, and honesty is never followed by embers

settings.becoming: I am becoming someone who is free of this.

never: This is what free looks like

visits.what: told last night's slip this morning: the chip says when, not made-up hours
told one free night; the two before it were never told, so Today counts one
four nights not told, answered honestly in the catch-up (3 slips): the fire is lit, not embers
nothing told for days: the fire says what was not told, and how to light it
told a free night: the fire is lit again at once
